fact: On 28 February 2024 the Public Service Minister told the Prime Minister that CNIAPGE, the national centre computerising the public administration, has only three programmers who cannot cope, and the Prime Minister worried that ministries lack trained technical staff to maintain their web pages.
title: Roka Botey muestra su descontento por el retraso en la informatización de algunos ministerios
publisher: Página Oficial del Gobierno de la República de Guinea Ecuatorial
